title: A looping motion moves on the canvas while it plays
goal: When a picture with a looping motion plays, the Actual sizes previews swing and the playhead runs, but the shape on the main canvas sits still. A person animating an icon cannot see the motion where they are working.
notes: Reproduced 2026-11-06. Insert {"do":"expectPictureMoves","seconds":0.2} after the second {"do":"key","key":"space"} of Scripts/playtest/motion-loop-preview-walk.json and run Scripts/playtest.sh on it with --no-build. Output: '[29 expectPictureMoves] FAILED: the canvas's picture stood still for 0.2s'. Two window captures 0.2 s apart showed the previews at different angles, the strip's playhead moved, and the main canvas square and its selection flat in both. NOT the crisp tile cause that froze keyed pictures: letting the tile go on every play in Next (letGoOfCrispTileForPlay, EditorState.swift) left this check failing, so that widening was reverted. Unconfirmed: the cause, and whether a first play is affected. EditorState.displayDocument does ask for document.moved(toMotionTimeMS:) while isMotionPlaying, so look past it. Walks stayed green because they only read 'playing'.
acceptance: With a looping Rotation on a picked shape, stopped with Space and played again, the shape on the main canvas turns as the previews do
motion-loop-preview-walk carries expectPictureMoves straight after that second Space and passes at Next defaults
Find out and write down whether the canvas also stands still on the first play after Add Motion, or only after a stop
